9. The likely cause is a bug in `RegulaFalsiSolver`'s iteration logic failing to detect no convergence in edge cases, or infinite loops or returned values when the interval bracketing does not sufficiently reduce.
10. Recent bug reports retrieved are not related to root-finders or bracketing solvers and do not help diagnose this regression.
